provenance.notes: `system` is the extraction contract that goes in the system block; each key is the pitch as the user turn. Recording the contract separately is what makes an inverted contract ('never infer' -> 'infer freely') a loud UnrecordedPromptError instead of a silent replay of the old reviewed answer. Replies are JSON strings so RecordedLLM.complete_json() parses them directly. Field names are illustrative of the extraction shape only - packages/contracts (T-010) owns the authoritative Claim schema, and T-021 owns the extractor.
